Showcase day

In the last lesson, families come to play what you made. Half the class shows their programs while the other half walks around, then you swap. No stage, no speech.

Visitors get question cards like "Show me the line that makes it decide". You get sentence starters so you always know what to say.

For schools and hosts

Three ready-to-run rooms with tested materials. You provide a room, laptops and the children. The instructor brings everything else.

The three rooms at a glance

Software: Thonny

All three rooms use Thonny, a free editor built for beginners. It installs with Python bundled, runs offline, needs no accounts and suits school computers. A portable version runs from a USB stick where installs aren't allowed.

Only Python's standard library is used. If a file breaks, a fresh copy fixes it.

The host provides

  • A room with a projector
  • One laptop per child with Thonny installed
  • A staff member present for safeguarding
  • Parent sign-up and photo consent
  • For the Junior Room: a second adult
